meanings.usage: 指来自其他国家的人或生物

meanings.meaning: 异国的（形容对某人来说不熟悉、格格不入的事物） n.. 外国人

meanings.usage: 用于描述非常悲伤、令人痛心的事件或情况
指从本国移居到另一个国家，强调离开的动作
be absorbed in表示专注于某事，沉迷其中
指因失去某人或某事而感到悲伤和痛苦
修饰形容词或动词，表示达到致死的程度
字面意思是道路上的里程标记，比喻人生或历史上的重要阶段
表示对某事非常有把握、确定无疑
通常指教堂或塔楼顶部的尖形结构
指将某物置于水面以下，或被水覆盖
指人工建造的用于储水的水体
指乡村的小房子，通常只有一层或两层
指收回说过的话或采取的行动，也可指缩回
指令人恐惧或痛苦的梦，也比喻可怕的经历
指快速地看一眼，强调动作的短暂性

examples.en: I stopped to let the car cool off.
examples.zh: 我停下来让汽车冷却下来。

examples.en: He became absorbed in making a new life for the two of us.
examples.zh: 他全神贯注地为我们俩创造新生活。

examples.en: I lacked for nothing, for he was both father and mother to me.
examples.zh: 我什么都不缺，因为他既当父亲又当母亲。

examples.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
examples.zh: 我认定我一定是某个地方拐错弯了。

examples.en: The spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance.
examples.zh: 我们村庄教堂的尖顶在远处显现出来。

examples.en: There was nobody in sight to help me.
examples.zh: 看不到有任何人在场能帮我。

examples.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
examples.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下来。

examples.en: He made me promise to go on my own.
As I was wondering what to do next, a man appeared.
examples.zh: 正当我在想下一步该怎么办时，一个人出现了。

examples.en: This time he pointed to the lake.

grammar.title: 过去完成时（Past Perfect Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作或状态，即"过去的过去" 当叙述过去发生的事件时，需要表示更早发生的动作或情况时使用。常与by the time, before, after等连用，或用于宾语从句中表示过去的过去。

examples.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now.
examples.zh: 我原本以为现在已经接近目的地了。

examples.en: I was only five when my father had taken me abroad.
examples.zh: 我父亲带我出国时我只有五岁。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时（Past Perfect Continuous）
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间之前一直在进行的动作 强调动作的持续性和进行过程，常与for或since连用。

examples.en: He had been describing over and over again what we should see.
examples.zh: 他曾一遍又一遍地描述我们会看到什么。

grammar.title: used to 与 would 的区别
grammar.structure: used to + 动词原形 / would + 动词原形
grammar.definition: used to表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，常含有与现在对比的意味；would只表示过去反复发生的动作，不表示状态 used to可以表示"曾经是"（状态）或"过去常常"（动作），而would只用于重复的动作。

examples.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
examples.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下来。

examples.en: My father had described over and over again what we should see.
examples.zh: 我父亲曾一遍又一遍地描述我们会看到什么。

patterns.pattern: I had expected to + 动词原形, but...

original.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now, but everything still seemed alien to me.
original.zh: 我原本以为现在已经接近目的地了，但一切对我来说仍然很陌生。

imitations.en: I had expected to finish the work on time, but I ran out of time.
imitations.zh: 我原本以为能按时完成工作，但我时间不够了。

imitations.en: She had expected to meet him at the station, but he never came.
imitations.zh: 她原本以为会在车站见到他，但他根本没来。

original.en: It was not that I actually remembered anything at all. But my father had described over and over again...
original.zh: 并不是我真的记得什么。而是我父亲曾一遍又一遍地描述……

imitations.en: It was not that she didn't want to help, but she really had no time.
imitations.zh: 并不是她不想帮忙，而是她真的没有时间。

imitations.en: It was not that he was lazy, but he simply didn't know how to start.
imitations.zh: 并不是他懒惰，而是他根本不知道如何开始。

original.en: The curious thing was that the lake was not marked on the map.
original.zh: 奇怪的是那个湖在地图上并没有标注。

imitations.en: The curious thing was that he knew the answer but refused to tell.
imitations.zh: 奇怪的是他知道答案却不肯说。

imitations.en: The curious thing was that the door was open but nobody was inside.
imitations.zh: 奇怪的是门开着但里面没有人。

original.en: The village no longer existed because it had been submerged.
original.zh: 那个村庄不再存在了，因为它已经被淹没了。

imitations.en: He no longer lives in this city.
imitations.zh: 他不再住在这个城市了。

imitations.en: This factory no longer produces plastic bags.
imitations.zh: 这家工厂不再生产塑料袋了。

lines.en: I stopped to let the car cool off and to study the map.
lines.zh: 我停下车，让汽车发动机冷却一下，同时查看一下地图。

lines.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now, but everything still seemed alien to me.
lines.zh: 我本想离目的地已经不远，但周围一切对我仍很陌生。

lines.en: I was only five when my father had taken me abroad, and that we eighteen years ago.
lines.zh: 我5岁那年，父亲就带我出了国，那是18年前的事了。

lines.en: When my mother had died after a tragic accident, he did not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness.
lines.zh: 当时我母亲在一次事故中惨死，父亲未能很快从悲痛与孤独中恢复过来。

lines.en: Everything around him was full of her presence, continually reopening the wound.
lines.zh: 他身边的一切都是母亲的影子不断勾起他的伤感。

lines.en: So he decided to emigrate.
lines.zh: 于是他决定移居他国。

lines.en: In the new country he became absorbed in making a new life for the two of us, so that he gradually ceased to grieve.
lines.zh: 在这个新的国家里，父亲专心致志地为我们俩开创一种新的生活，慢慢地不伤心了。

lines.en: He did not marry again and I was brought up without a woman's care; but I lacked for nothing, for he was both father and mother to me.
lines.zh: 父亲没有再娶，因此，我在没有母亲的环境里长大成人。但我却什么都不缺，他既当父亲又当母亲。

lines.en: He always meant to go back on day, but not to stay.
lines.zh: 他总想将来回国看看，但却不愿长期住下去，因为他与我一样已经把根深深地扎在异国的土地上。

lines.en: His roots and mine bad become too firmly embedded in the new land.
lines.zh: 但是，他想看一看家乡父老乡亲，为我的母亲扫墓。

lines.en: But he wanted to see the old folk again and to visit my mother's grave.
lines.zh: 就在他计划回国的前几个月，他突然身患绝症。

lines.en: He became mortally ill a few months before we had planned to go and, when he knew that he was dying, he made me promise to go on my own.
lines.zh: 他知道自己已奄奄一息，于是他要我答应一定单独回故乡一趟。

lines.en: I hired a car the day after landing and bought a comprehensive book of maps, which I found most helpful on the cross-country journey, but which I did not think I should need on the last stage.
lines.zh: 我下飞机后租了一辆车，并买了一本详尽的地图册。在乡间行车途中，我觉得它非常有用，但快到家了，我倒觉得它没什么用了。

lines.en: It was not that I actually remembered anything at all.
lines.zh: 这倒并非是我背熟了地图，而是父亲曾详细给我讲了，在过了离故乡最近的那个小镇后，在每一个路标处可见到些什么。

lines.en: But my father had described over and over again what we should see at every milestone , after leaving the nearest town, so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory.
lines.zh: 因此，我相信这段路对我来说会是很熟悉的。

lines.en: Well, I had been wrong, for I was now lost.
lines.zh: 唉，实际我错了，我现在迷路了。

lines.en: I looked at the map and then at the millimeter.
lines.zh: 我看了看地图，又查了一下里程表。

lines.en: I had come ten miles since leaving the town, and at this point, according to my father, I should be looking at farms and cottages in a valley, with the spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance.
lines.zh: 从小镇出来，我走了10英里。照父亲的说法，我面前应是一个山谷，有农场与村舍，还可远远望见老家村子里的教堂的尖顶。

lines.en: I could see no valley, no farms, no cottages and no church spire -- only a lake.
lines.zh: 可现在我却看不出山谷，看不见农舍，也看见教学尖顶，看见只是一片湖泊。

lines.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
lines.zh: 我想一定是什么地方拐错了弯儿。

lines.en: So I drove back to the town and began to retrace the route, taking frequent glances at the map.
lines.zh: 于是我驾车返回小镇，重新按路线行驶。

lines.en: I landed up at the same corner.
lines.zh: 结果又来到刚才那个拐弯处。

lines.en: The curious thing was that the lake was not marked on the map.
lines.zh: 奇怪的是那个湖没有在地图上标出。

lines.en: I left as if I had stumbled into a nightmare country, as you sometimes do in dreams.
lines.zh: 我感到自己就像平时作梦那样迷迷糊糊地闯进了恶梦境地。

lines.en: And, as in a nightmare, there was nobody in sight to help me.
lines.zh: 就像在恶梦里一样，见不到一个人可以帮助我。

lines.en: Fortunately for me, as I was wondering what to do next, there appeared on the horizon a man on horseback, riding in my direction.
lines.zh: 不过，我是幸运的，正当我走投无路之时，从天边出现一个骑马的人向我骑来。

lines.en: I waited till he came near, then I asked him the way to our old village.
lines.zh: 等他走近了，问他去老家的路。

lines.en: He said that there was now no village.
lines.zh: 他说那村子已经没有了。

lines.en: I thought he must have misunderstood me, so I repeated its name.
lines.zh: 我想他一定误解了我的意思，于是又说一遍村庄的名字。

lines.en: This time he pointed to the lake.
lines.zh: 这次他用手指了一下那个湖。

lines.en: The village no longer existed because it had been submerged, and all the valley too.
lines.zh: 村庄已不复存在，因为已经为水所淹，山谷也被水淹没了。

lines.en: The lake was not a natural one, but a man-made reservoir.
lines.zh: 这不是一个天然湖泊，是一座人工修建的水库。

questions.q: Did the narrator find is mother's grave?
questions.zh: 叙述者找到他母亲的墓地了吗？
questions.a: No, he did not. The village no longer existed, because it and all the valley had been submerged; the lake he saw was in fact a man-made reservoir, so there was no village, no church spire and no grave to visit.
questions.aZh: 没有找到。那个村子已不复存在，它和整个山谷都被水淹没，他看见的湖其实是一座人工水库，因此既没有村子，也没有教堂尖顶和墓地。
questions.hint: 见课文倒数三句：He said that there was now no village… The village no longer existed because it had been submerged, and all the valley too. The lake was not a natural one, but a man-made reservoir.

questions.q: Why did the narrator's father decide to emigrate?
questions.zh: 叙述者的父亲为什么决定移居国外？
questions.a: Because after his wife's death in a tragic accident he could not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness, and everything around him was full of her presence, continually reopening the wound. So he decided to emigrate.
questions.aZh: 因为妻子在一次事故中惨死后，他久久无法从打击与孤独中恢复过来，身边的一切都是她的影子，不断勾起他的伤感，于是他决定移居他国。
questions.hint: 见课文第四、五、六句，注意 continually reopening the wound。

questions.q: How did the father rebuild the family's life in the new country?
questions.zh: 父亲在新的国家里怎样重建父子二人的生活？
questions.a: He became absorbed in making a new life for the two of them, so that he gradually ceased to grieve. He did not marry again, and though the narrator was brought up without a woman's care, he lacked for nothing, for his father was both father and mother to him.
questions.aZh: 他专心致志地为父子俩开创新生活，渐渐不再伤心。他没有再娶，虽然叙述者在没有母亲照料的环境里长大，却什么都不缺，因为父亲既当父亲又当母亲。
questions.hint: 见课文第七、八句，注意 be（become）absorbed in 与 lack for nothing。

questions.q: What did the narrator expect to see ten miles from the town, and what did he see instead?
questions.zh: 出小镇十英里后，叙述者本应看到什么？实际看到的又是什么？
questions.a: According to his father, he should have been looking at farms and cottages in a valley, with the spire of the church of their village showing in the far distance. But he could see no valley, no farms, no cottages and no church spire — only a lake.
questions.aZh: 按父亲的说法，他本应看到山谷里的农场和村舍，远处还有老家教堂的尖顶。可他既看不到山谷、农场和村舍，也看不到教堂尖顶，只见一片湖水。
questions.hint: 见课文第十八、十九句，注意 should be looking at 与 only a lake 的对照。

questions.q: Why does the narrator's homecoming turn out to be a journey into 'a nightmare country'?
questions.zh: 为什么这次归乡之旅竟成了一场“噩梦之地”？
questions.a: Because nothing his father had described still existed: the village and all the valley had been submerged, and the lake that puzzled him was not a natural one but a man-made reservoir covering his home. His father's careful account of every milestone only made the loss harder, and there was nobody in sight to help him.
questions.aZh: 因为父亲讲过的一切都已不复存在：村子与整个山谷被水淹没，那片令他困惑的湖并非天然，而是盖在他故乡之上的人工水库。父亲对每个路标的细致描述反而让这份失落更重，而四顾无人可以求助。
questions.hint: 见课文最后五句，尤其 the lake was not marked on the map 与 not a natural one, but a man-made reservoir。

translation:
我停下车，让汽车发动机冷却一下，同时查看一下地图。
我本想离目的地已经不远，但周围一切对我仍很陌生。
我5岁那年，父亲就带我出了国，那是18年前的事了。
当时我母亲在一次事故中惨死，父亲未能很快从悲痛与孤独中恢复过来。
他身边的一切都是母亲的影子不断勾起他的伤感。
于是他决定移居他国。
在这个新的国家里，父亲专心致志地为我们俩开创一种新的生活，慢慢地不伤心了。
父亲没有再娶，因此，我在没有母亲的环境里长大成人。
但我却什么都不缺，他既当父亲又当母亲。
他总想将来回国看看，但却不愿长期住下去，因为他与我一样已经把根深深地扎在异国的土地上。
但是，他想看一看家乡父老乡亲，为我的母亲扫墓。
就在他计划回国的前几个月，他突然身患绝症。
他知道自己已奄奄一息，于是他要我答应一定单独回故乡一趟。
我下飞机后租了一辆车，并买了一本详尽的地图册。
在乡间行车途中，我觉得它非常有用，但快到家了，我倒觉得它没什么用了。
这倒并非是我背熟了地图，而是父亲曾详细给我讲了，在过了离故乡最近的那个小镇后，在每一个路标处可见到些什么。
因此，我相信这段路对我来说会是很熟悉的。
唉，实际我错了，我现在迷路了。
我看了看地图，又查了一下里程表。
从小镇出来，我走了10英里。
照父亲的说法，我面前应是一个山谷，有农场与村舍，还可远远望见老家村子里的教堂的尖顶。
可现在我却看不出山谷，看不见农舍，也看见教学尖顶，看见只是一片湖泊。
我想一定是什么地方拐错了弯儿。
于是我驾车返回小镇，重新按路线行驶。
结果又来到刚才那个拐弯处。
奇怪的是那个湖没有在地图上标出。
我感到自己就像平时作梦那样迷迷糊糊地闯进了恶梦境地。
就像在恶梦里一样，见不到一个人可以帮助我。
不过，我是幸运的，正当我走投无路之时，从天边出现一个骑马的人向我骑来。
等他走近了，问他去老家的路。
他说那村子已经没有了。
我想他一定误解了我的意思，于是又说一遍村庄的名字。
这次他用手指了一下那个湖。
村庄已不复存在，因为已经为水所淹，山谷也被水淹没了。
这不是一个天然湖泊，是一座人工修建的水库。
title: Back in the Old Country
subtitle: 重返故里

lead.question: 满怀期待重返故里，为何叙述者连母亲的墓地都找不到？
lead.warmup: 本课是一篇游子归乡记：父亲在他五岁时带他出国，母亲惨死后，父亲决意移居异国，把根扎在了新的土地上。临终前，他要儿子独自回故乡，代自己为母亲扫墓。儿子租车、买地图，靠父亲反复描述的路标辨路，却在一片本不该有湖的地方迷了路。请留意 as if 虚拟句与分词状语写出的失落与错愕。
goals: 读懂叙述者一家离乡、扎根异国又重返故里的情感脉络。
掌握 native country、emigrate、foreign、familiar、submerge 等本课核心词汇。
辨析 It was not that...but that...、must have done 与 as if 虚拟句的用法。
学会用定语从句和分词状语把叙述写得连贯而有画面感。
lead.summary: 叙述者五岁随父出国，母亲死于意外后，父亲为摆脱伤痛而移居异国，从此既当父亲又当母亲，根也扎在了新的土地上。他一直想回故乡，却不愿久留；病重时他要儿子代自己返乡扫墓。他租车买图，凭父亲讲过的路标认路，却在十英里外只见到一片湖。一位骑马人告诉他：村子与山谷已被水淹没，那湖是人工水库。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：emigrate 指“移出”本国，immigrate 指“移入”他国，切勿混用；he made me promise to go on my own 中 promise 前不加 to，on one's own 意为“独自、靠自己”。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他决定离开祖国，移居国外。
exercises.a: He decided to leave his native country and emigrate.
exercises.note: native country 祖国；emigrate 移出

exercises.q: 汉译英：我确信这段路对我来说会是很熟悉的。
exercises.a: I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory.

exercises.q: 填空：He did not marry again, and I was brought up in a ___ country without a woman's care; but I ___ for nothing.
句型转换：用 as if 改写为虚拟语气——It seemed that I had stumbled into a nightmare country.
exercises.a: I felt as if I had stumbled into a nightmare country.
exercises.note: as if + 过去完成表虚拟

exercises.q: 句型转换：用非限制性定语从句合并——I bought a comprehensive book of maps. I found it most helpful on the cross-country journey.
exercises.a: I bought a comprehensive book of maps, which I found most helpful on the cross-country journey.
exercises.note: which 引非限制性定语从句

exercises.q: 改错：I decided that I must took a wrong turning somewhere.
exercises.a: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
exercises.note: must have done 推测过去

exercises.q: 用现在分词改写：Everything around him was full of her presence and it continually reopened the wound.
exercises.a: Everything around him was full of her presence, continually reopening the wound.

quiz.q: 叙述者最终找到母亲的墓地了吗？
options: No. The village and all the valley had been submerged.
Yes, after he asked a man on horseback the way.
Yes, he found it beside the old church spire.
No, because he never reached his native country at all.

quiz.q: 父亲为什么决定移居国外？
options: Because everything around him reminded him of his dead wife.
Because he wanted to make a fortune in a new country.
Because his son had begged him to leave the old country.
Because there was no work for him in his native country.

quiz.q: 父亲在新国家里的生活是怎样的？
options: He became absorbed in making a new life and gradually ceased to grieve.
He married again and soon forgot his first wife.
He never made any friends and never ceased to grieve.
He went back to his old village to settle for good.
quiz.note: 专心开创新生活，渐不再伤心

quiz.q: 关于那本详尽的地图册，下面哪句符合课文？
options: He found it most helpful on the cross-country journey but did not think he should need it on the last stage.
He never opened it once during the whole journey.
He bought it only after he had lost his way near the town.
It clearly marked the man-made reservoir in the valley.
quiz.note: 长途有用，末段以为不需

quiz.q: 父亲对最后一段路的描述是什么？
options: He should be looking at farms and cottages in a valley, with the church spire in the far distance.
He should be crossing a wide river by a covered bridge.
He should be passing a railway station and a busy market town.
He should be driving through a thick forest for ten miles.
quiz.note: 十英里后应见村舍与尖顶

quiz.q: “The lake was not a natural one, but a man-made reservoir.” 这句话说明了什么？
options: A reservoir had been built and it had drowned the village and the whole valley.
The lake had always been there but was missing from his map.
A long drought had turned a natural lake into a reservoir.
His father had described this lake to him years before.
quiz.note: 水库淹没了村庄与山谷
